segments.label: Outer left column
segments.notes: Terminates Wall 1 on the left. 8in wide x 9.25in deep. Reads more structurally defined than the wall returns.

segments.label: Left open shelf bay
segments.notes: Open shelves only, 9.25in deep, aligned with the column depth. Boards attach directly between C1 and C2. No bookcase box, no inset built-in, no side panels, no base cabinet.

segments.label: Inner left column
segments.notes: 8in wide x 9.25in deep. Flanks the left shelf bay and the left wall return.

segments.label: Left wall return
segments.notes: Wall return, 12.75in, flush with the wall plane. Plain plaster, no seams. Stays flat and quiet and is never absorbed into the window unit, its casing, the columns, or the shelves.

segments.label: Left window casing
segments.notes: 5in casing. The window carries 5in casing all around. Painted white.

segments.label: Main window unit
segments.notes: 96in x 60in window. Side lights (22in each) carry a grid pattern. Center panel (52in) stays clear with no grid. Frame and mullions are white.

segments.label: Right window casing
segments.notes: 5in casing. The window carries 5in casing all around. Painted white.

segments.label: Right wall return
segments.notes: Wall return, 12.75in, flush with the wall plane. Plain plaster, no seams. Stays flat and quiet and is never absorbed into the window unit, its casing, the columns, or the shelves.

segments.label: Inner right column
segments.notes: 8in wide x 9.25in deep. Flanks the right wall return and the right shelf bay.

segments.label: Right open shelf bay
segments.notes: Open shelves only, 9.25in deep, aligned with the column depth. Boards attach directly between C3 and C4. No bookcase box, no inset built-in, no side panels, no base cabinet.

segments.label: Outer right column
segments.notes: Terminates Wall 1 on the right. 8in wide x 9.25in deep. Reads more structurally defined than the wall returns.

rules: C1 and C4 terminate Wall 1. Nothing on this wall extends past them.
Open shelves are 9.25in deep and align with the column depth.
Shelves attach directly between the flanking columns. No bookcase boxes, no inset built-ins, no side panels.
Shelves read as boards, not as cabinets or bookcases.
Z2 and Z4 are flush wall returns, 12.75in each, in plain plaster with no seams.
Wall returns stay flat and quiet. Structures, openings, casing, and shelves never absorb a wall return.
Clear wall returns beside the window remain separate locked zones and are not absorbed into the window unit.
Columns read more structurally defined than the wall returns.
The window carries 5in casing all around. Z3A and Z3C are its 5in vertical legs.
Window frame and mullions are white.
Side lights carry a grid pattern. The center window panel stays clear.
Global IDs are continuous across the room and do not restart wall by wall.
Photoreal rendering uses a persistent structural lock rule.
Renderer may color, texture, shadow, and enhance lines only inside the measured framework.
